task_specification.objective: Repair the three host-gated product surfaces in one bounded loop: restore readable traversable cemetery framing, collision, landmark visibility, and nocturnal lighting; reinstate causally bounded automatic-attack audio plus authored upgrade-choice hierarchy; and enable native-renderer dense-profile timing instrumentation while preserving accepted assets and lifecycle behavior.

diagnosis.root_cause: Release-convergence failures split into three root causes: cemetery presentation is tightly framed with weak warm/cool exposure separation; automatic combat has no audible firearm transient in the Effects mix; and dense profiling remains software-renderer-only with zero native timing samples.

stop_conditions: Do not replace or surgically modify the preserved authored cemetery package or retained gun/viewmodel assets.
Stop after the three bounded implementation families and candidate self-checks are complete; host recapture, formal verdicts, and issue closure remain validation responsibilities.
Do not expand into deferred backlog gaps or unrelated lifecycle/content work.

strategy.rationale: Partition each required gap and active issue exactly once by root cause: spatial/composition, player-facing combat/presentation integration, and dense performance qualification. Use materially different integration-layer repairs from prior transform-only, exposure-only, audio-capture, or software-profile treatments.

code: Run focused static/self-checks for scene/world bindings and collision-anchor assertions; weapon audio event-count/envelope and AUTO lifecycle tests; upgrade-card value/focus tests; and dense-profile renderer identity/nonzero-sample checks.
Run preserved native_godot_project and host_godot_boot checks after edits.
Confirm no deferred backlog gaps are touched and all target paths remain candidate-relative and bounded.
runtime: Host/GameLoop Runtime recaptures spawn, critical route, and cardinal/landmark views plus movement replay for collision/visibility; SEMI and quick AUTO mixed Effects capture with source-event timeline; native-renderer dense profile with timing samples and population counters.
Tester performs black-box and white-box retests for all four active issue ids, verifies preserved authored map and retained gun/viewmodel hierarchy, and owns formal pass/fail and issue closure.
visual: Compare same-framing before/after gameplay screenshots for warm lantern/cool moon hierarchy, central building/landmark visibility, external depth, perimeter boundary, and ordinary traversal readability.
Review upgrade draft at native and supported UI scales for silhouette-led hierarchy, truthful deltas, placeholder-free CURRENT values, and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states.

Inspect adjacent fire frames and mixed audio evidence for one recognizable firearm transient without long ringing impact masking; review dense-profile presentation for renderer identity and legible timing samples.

done_when: Arena uses a larger traversable scale or equivalent expand treatment while retaining the intact authored environment as the sole visual map.
A coherent external world/external depth surrounds the playable cemetery; the central building/landmark remains visible without dominating or causing gameplay occlusion.
Native streets/terrain, perimeter/boundary, spawn/objective anchors, and collision remain aligned during ordinary movement/movement replay with no disappearance or occlusion drift.
Warm lantern/candle pools and cooler moon/fill separation are visibly readable in spawn, route, and cardinal/landmark views; no blue-green flat wash remains.
Candidate self-checks cover camera framing, world visibility, collision, and lighting bindings without altering preserved authored child meshes.
tasks.instructions: Repair authored cemetery presentation and spatial integration at the scene/world adapter layer. Inspect the existing map binding, camera/framing, outer datum, spawn/objective anchors, and lighting/material overrides. Rebase gameplay framing onto native streets, expand the traversable scale where needed, preserve the intact authored environment package, and add only product-owned collision/navigation/boundary/anchor support. Establish a deliberate warm practical versus cool moon hierarchy so the central building/landmark and perimeter read clearly from ordinary movement. Add candidate-owned checks for aligned collision, visibility, and no disappearance/occlusion under movement replay; do not replace the map or add proxy roads, floor patches, or duplicated landmarks.
tasks.title: Restore cemetery scale, framing, collision, and nocturnal exposure

done_when: One SEMI click and one quick AUTO tap each emit exactly one short, recognizable firearm transient on the actual mixed Effects output.
The component FireAudio/AutoFireAudio path remains the sole player-report owner; generic shot VFX does not replay the complete player recording.

Native component report, product adapter report, miss, concrete-hit, metal-hit, and character-hit stems are isolated or tagged in candidate instrumentation so the host can verify causality and no long ringing impact masks the report.
AUTO continuation starts only after cadence-valid continuation, stops on release, and resets cleanly with lifecycle reset; retained gun/viewmodel assets and timings remain unchanged.

Upgrade choices lead with authored weapon/upgrade silhouettes, use compact stat icons, show truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, omit unchanged or placeholder CURRENT values, and provide distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/selected states without changing card dimensions.

Candidate self-checks validate Effects routing, cue duration/envelope, single-event emission for SEMI/AUTO, and upgrade-card eligibility/value normalization without requiring unavailable external capture.
tasks.instructions: Repair automatic-attack audio in the product-owned weapon/combat adapter and report presenter, keeping retained component gun audio and viewmodel hierarchy read-only. Trace SEMI and AUTO paths, ensure one bounded firearm transient per trigger event in mixed Effects output, and separate player report from miss, concrete/metal impact, and character-hit cues. Add source-event IDs/timestamps and bounded envelopes sufficient for host capture to prove causality; gate sustained AUTO on cadence-valid continuation and stop/reset on release or lifecycle reset. If surface tags are unreliable, disable player world-surface impact audio while retaining compact impact VFX and character-hit feedback. In the same player-facing presentation integration, repair or verify the upgrade draft so each choice is silhouette-led, icon-led, truthful, limited to three changed stats, free of NEW/LOCKED placeholders in CURRENT, and fully focusable by keyboard, mouse, and gamepad.
tasks.title: Restore firearm transient causality and authored choice hierarchy

done_when: Dense profile can be run on the native renderer (not software-renderer-only) with zero timing samples reported as a failure.

Instrumentation is isolated from gameplay behavior and preserves dense reset isolation, spawn safety, and existing mesh/runtime validations.
Self-checks confirm no runtime/editor errors and that the profile report distinguishes native renderer from software fallback and contains nonzero frame, physics, and render samples.
tasks.instructions: Replace the software-renderer-only dense-profile path with native-renderer-compatible timing instrumentation and deterministic bounded capture. Inspect renderer/runtime configuration, dense-profile setup, and profiling/report code; add explicit renderer identity, frame/physics/render timing samples, and population counters while keeping instrumentation lightweight and behavior-preserving. Ensure a native-renderer run produces nonzero samples and clearly labels software fallback if encountered, without changing combat, spawn, or reset semantics.
